description: Search investing people — partners, principals, associates, scouts, venture partners, fund GPs, angels, syndicate leads — by role, firm, the firm's sector, the firm's HQ geography, or name. Returns each person's current firms and which kinds of contact route they published (email, LinkedIn, X, personal site). Only people in an investing role are included. People and their contact routes come from public sources — the firm's own site or the person's own published page — and every route carries the page it was published on and the quoted text showing it. Phone numbers and home addresses are never collected. Anyone can request removal at support@pipeworx.io.

firm.description: Firm name, partial match over names and aliases

geo.description: The firm's HQ country or region, e.g. "US", "United States", "europe"

role.description: Investing role: partner, principal, associate, scout, venture_partner, operating_partner, angel, syndicate_lead, solo_gp, fund_gp, other_investor (or an org role such as gp, managing_director)

sector.description: The firm's sector: a normalized leaf (e.g. "ai_infrastructure") or the firm's own stated tag

with_contact.description: Only people who published at least one contact route

name: vc_search_people
title: Vc Search People
